snippet.title: Doomy in the Roomy: Developer Commentary
snippet.description:
Eyo, welcome back to another developer commentary, this time we're playing through Doomy in the Roomy. Beaten the shit out of it long ago, but do my skills still hold up? Will I be able to beat the boss first try? Who knows man, I just wanna eat lunch.
